an9.20:9.2: feeding a hundred of those accomplished in view, feeding one once-returner …
an9.20:9.3: feeding a hundred once-returners, feeding one non-returner …
an9.20:9.4: feeding a hundred non-returners, feeding one perfected one …
an9.20:9.5: feeding a hundred perfected ones, feeding one independent Buddha …
an9.20:9.6: feeding a hundred independent Buddhas, feeding a Realized One, a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha …
an9.20:9.7: feeding the mendicant Saṅgha headed by the Buddha, building a dwelling especially for the Saṅgha of the four quarters …
an9.20:9.8: going for refuge to the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha with a confident heart, undertaking the training rules with a confident heart—
an9.20:9.9: not to kill living creatures … or consume intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor; developing a heart of love even just as long as it takes to pull a cow’s udder; and developing the perception of impermanence even as long as a finger-snap—this is more fruitful than all of that.”
